headline: Legacy Law Offices acts on HGS India IPO

detail: HGS (India) Limited has successfully completed its Initial Public Offering on the NSE SME platform for a book-built offer for a fresh issue of 23,26,000 shares, and an offer for sale of 5,54,000 shares, with an offer size of approximately ₹35 crore. Legacy Law Offices advised and acted as the legal counsel for HGS India, the Book Running Lead Manager Hem Securities Limited, and the Selling Shareholders (Pawan Singh, Anjali Singh, Beena Dosija, Karan Singh, Preneet Kaur, Anil Seth, Archna Dosija, Girrendra Kaur, Veena Uttamsingh, Anil Henrik Ramel Singh, and Chaya Cecilia Ramel Homann) on this SME IPO. The transaction team comprised of Priya Kataria (Associate Partner), Naman Anand (Counsel)…
